iconName.description: Resulting icon name; omitted if absent.

sharedWith.description: Sharing target references, omitted if absent; not modified by this tool.

functions.name: update-transcript-chunk
functions.description: Partially correct a transcript segment's text, speaker, relative interval or deletion metadata.

callId.description: Opaque identifier of the parent call.

chunkId.description: Opaque transcript chunk identifier within the call.

text.description: Replacement transcribed text; empty text explicitly requests an empty segment.

deleted.description: Explicit replacement soft-deletion flag; does not automatically change deletedAt.

speaker.description: Replacement speaker identification text, not necessarily an account ID.

startSeconds.description: Replacement start offset in seconds relative to call start, with no silent rounding; provider units require validation.

text.description: Stored ordinary transcript text after the patch.

deletedAt.description: Returned deletion stamp normalized to UTC Z, retaining null or absence.
